LMER point-range plot

Source: R/plot_lmer.R
plot_lmer.Rd

Produces the "point-range" plot used in the NUMAB reports to visualize a linear mixed model: observed mean +/- SE per combination of an x-axis variable and a grouping variable, faceted by protein. If `lme4` is available and a random-effect subject column is supplied, a linear mixed model `value ~ x * group + (1 | random)` is fitted per protein and the group-effect p-value is annotated on each panel.

Usage

plot_lmer(
  data,
  assay = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  random = NULL,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  lod_col = NULL,
  show_lod = FALSE,
  ci_level = 0.95,
  add_pvalue = FALSE,
  dodge_width = 0.2,
  palette = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in long format, or an OlinkExperiment.

assay

Optional assay name(s) to plot. If NULL, all assays are plotted and the plot is faceted by assay.

x

Name of the x-axis variable (e.g. "Timepoint"). If NULL, auto-detected.

group

Column name for the grouping/color variable (e.g. "TreatGroup"). If NULL, auto-detected.

random

Optional column name for the random-effect subject identifier (e.g. "PPID"). Required to fit the mixed model.

assay_col

Name of the assay column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

value_col

Name of the NPX value column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "NPX").

lod_col

Optional column name holding an LOD value; draws a dashed LOD reference line when supplied.

show_lod

Logical; if `TRUE`, auto-detects the LOD column and draws a dashed reference line (default `FALSE`).

ci_level

Confidence level for the error bars (default 0.95).

add_pvalue

Logical; fit the mixed model and annotate the group-effect p-value per panel (default FALSE to keep the function dependency-light).

dodge_width

Horizontal offset between groups at the same x (default 0.2).

palette

Optional color palette for groups.

title

Plot title.

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::geom_errorbar()`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_lmer(
  numab_probc, assay = "IL6", x = "Timepoint",
  group = "TreatGroup", random = "PPID"
)
} # }
